dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...If anyone leaks the team's secrets, they shall be held accountable...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Phase 1: Ambush the Shogunate soldiers on a rainy night using our long-studied tactics, switch outfits with them, and obtain their ship's supplies.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Phase 2: Attack and break Shogunate's wards according to the methods Mr. Nathan explained, and restore the dignity of our great Omikami.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Stage 3: If the plan does not go well, sacrifice yourselves for our mighty Omikami. If things go well, you may retreat safely. But in neither case can you reveal your identity, thus implicating our Divine Priestess...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...The above information is to be kept strictly confidential. Not a word to anyone, whether it be Her Excellency the Divine Priestess or our lowest-ranking comrades. Those with loose lips will face the consequences...
